description:
The hospital IT team needs to ensure that system alerts are generated regularly. As the system administrator, you need to configure a new background job in the OpenMRS Scheduler.

1. Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (https://localhost/openmrs/admin).
2. Log in with 'superman' / 'Admin123'.
3. Go to the Scheduler management section.
4. Add a new Task with these details:
   - Name: Hourly Alert Sync
   - Schedulable Class: org.openmrs.scheduler.tasks.AlertReminderTask
   - Description: Background task to sync system alerts every hour
   - Repeat Interval: 3600 seconds
   - Start on Startup: Yes
5. Save the task.
6. IMPORTANT: Start the task so it is running.

The browser is currently open to the Bahmni home page.
